source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Select the report for the failed brake test.
3. Add as much detail as possible in the "Vehicles Problems" section of the inspection report.

When adding detail:

start with details of all front brakes including:

* left front brake has an estimated 30% remaining pad life
* right front brake has an estimated 30% remaining pad life

starting with the right front brake add details of all rear brakes including:

* left rear brake has an estimated 30% remaining pad life
* right rear brake has an estimated 30% remaining pad life

continue with details of all other/auxiliary brakes including:

* left front axle the brake lines have cracks
* left front axle more left front axle issues

**Optional** add photos below to highlight problem areas as follows:

* Picture taken of the left front wheel & tire combination facing left position.
* Picture taken of the left rear
